note: Sinks Canyon SP SW of Lander along the Middle Fork Popo Agie River. Two state campgrounds: Popo Agie (24 sites, 12 bookable RV pads, the rest tent sites) and Sawmill, 2.6 km down-canyon (4 RV sites; its two 40-ft parallel pull-throughs won't take slide-outs). Water is shut off mid-October. A separate USFS Sinks Canyon campground lies farther up-canyon. --Claude
summary: Booking site (US eDirect) read unit by unit: Popo Agie 12 RV pads (18-45 ft, 01 is 45) + 8 tent, Sawmill 4 RV (20-40 ft) + 1 tent, all non-electric, vault toilets, 14-night max; reservations May-Sep with sites 12/15 FCFS all year and everything FCFS Oct-Apr (season year_round manual left). Waterfront: river channel ~15-23 m wide (creek-size) and pads sit behind a riparian shrub/tree fringe -> riverfront re-audit lead. Pin is fine (Popo Agie). Sawmill is a split candidate.
flags: WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored riverfront, not --AWH): the Middle Fork Popo Agie here is a ~15-23 m whitewater channel on imagery, under the ~30 m line -> creekside at most. Closest RV pads: Popo Agie 03 (42.74098,-108.82519), 04 (42.74089,-108.82502), 05 (42.74107,-108.82461), booking site 'Short Walk', ~5-15 m from the water through a willow/shrub fringe; 11 (42.74132,-108.82231) and 13 (42.74129,-108.82196, tagged 'River' but an 18-ft pad) ~20-25 m through willows and trees. Sawmill 28 (42.75703,-108.79960) and 29 (42.75697,-108.79981), tagged 'River', ~15-20 m from the water under tree canopy. Reviewer: creekside if the fringe is judged open enough at 03-05, else creekview.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: Sawmill campground (sites 26-29 + TE25) sits 2.6 km down-canyon at ~42.7571,-108.7994 with its own entrance off WY-131, separate from Popo Agie (pin). Four RV sites: 26 (20 ft gravel), 27 (24 ft), 28 and 29 (40-ft parallel pull-throughs, 'Will not accommodate RV slide-outs').

FEES (manual, not overwritten): the booking site's unit pages now say 'Facility Fee $ 12-21/night' (Sawmill 'Fees Range From 12/21') with 'Fees shown represent Resident/Non-resident prices before tax', while the stored fees are the 2026 schedule's $10 / $18 base (+ day use, which is free here per the 2026-11-07 entrance fix). $12 / $21 may be a newer schedule or base + day use; the wyoparks fee page is behind the F5 challenge, so unconfirmed.

FIT: 12 Popo Agie RV pads: 01 45 ft, 04 40, 03/09/10 36, 24 35, 05/11/17/18/19 30, 13 18 (too short for 23 ft); site 17 'not recommended for RV's over 30ft'. Sawmill 26 is 20 ft (too short), 27 24 ft. A 23-ft rig fits 11 Popo Agie + 3 Sawmill sites.
